Search results indicate REEL's film festival features student films from Leadership Public Schools in Oakland, which matches the agenda item about LPS Oakland R&D, but this link was not confirmed on a fetched page
research.notes: No registry record (ProPublica, IRS, CA SOS) was found, so legal name, EIN and nonprofit status are unconfirmed. The connection to LPS Oakland R&D was not confirmed on a fetched page. Not publishable.

profile.summary: REEL is an after-school filmmaking program for Bay Area youth. Students write, produce and premiere their own short films, learning each step from concept to screen. The program works with schools in Oakland and nearby.
